name: g_debugLogRingIndex
comment: Current slot index (0..9) in the 10-entry debug log ring buffer (g_debugLogRingBuffers at 0x007C5A44). Incremented modulo 10 by Debug_AppendLogLine on each appended message.
evidence: Read and written by Debug_AppendLogLine (0x0015BCAC) via literal 0x0015BD18. Incremented and reduced modulo 10 via smull with 0x66666667, then scaled by 512 (lsl #9) to index into the 0x007C5A44 buffer.

name: g_debugLogRingBuffers
comment: Ring buffer of 10 UTF-16 string slots (each 256 u16 characters / 512 bytes, 2560 u16s total). Written by Debug_AppendLogLine via Str_Utf8ToUtf16Wrapped; returned pointers are passed to Ui_MessageWindow.
evidence: Referenced by Debug_AppendLogLine (0x0015BCAC) via literal 0x0015BD20. Indexed as base + index * 0x200 (lsl #9); Str_Utf8ToUtf16Wrapped converts input text into slot with capacity 0x100 u16s and strh NUL terminator.
